name: green-level-close-above
note: extend.until + terminate.close_above. Level L=close[1]=12. Bar 2 closes EXACTLY at 12, which is not a break (close_* is strict, design 0.5 §4); bar 3 closes 15 > 12 and terminates. x2 is inclusive (design 0.5 §3), so x2bar is the bar the predicate fired on.
source:
